traits.name: Hellish Revenge
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger The Nessian warhound is critically hit by any Strike. Effect The Nessian warhound's Breath Weapon recharges. It can immediately use it as part of this reaction.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.text: ⬻ (divine, evocation, fire); The warhound breathes flames that deal 10d6 (10d6) fire damage to all creatures in a 15-foot cone (DC 28 basic Reflex save.) The warhound can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds. If the Nessian warhound would take fire damage or be targeted by a fire effect, its Breath Weapon recharges.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ jaws +21 (magical); Damage 2d8+6 (2d8+6) piercing plus 1d6 (1d6) evil and 2d6 (2d6) fire
